part2.question: A home that you like to visit but do not want to live in

segments.v: I want to talk about my grandparents' house in Chuông village. It is about one hour from Hà Nội by car. It is an old house with one floor and a tiled roof. There is a big altar in the living room and old photos of my family. Behind the house there is a big garden with a pond and vegetables. I like visiting it because it is quiet and the air is fresh. My grandmother cooks delicious food with vegetables from her garden. I feel relaxed there. But I don't want to live there because it is far from my school and my friends. The internet is slow and there are many mosquitoes. It is also very hot in summer. I like living in the city more.
